mapper.sql: sku_id, prod_id, sku_code, properties, original_price, current_price, model_id, pic, sku_name, weight, volume, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku (prod_id, sku_code, properties, original_price, current_price, model_id, pic, sku_name, weight, volume, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{prodId}, #{skuCode}, #{properties}, #{originalPrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{modelId}, #{pic}, #{skuName}, #{weight}, #{volume}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sku SET prod_id = #{prodId}, sku_code = #{skuCode}, properties = #{properties}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, current_price = #{currentPrice}, model_id = #{modelId}, pic = #{pic}, sku_name = #{skuName}, weight = #{weight}, volume = #{volume}, status = #{status}, create_time = #{createTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
